lead_raw_text:
The structure of Sc4Co2 (Sc2Co) crystallizes in the hexagonal space group P6_3/mmc (No. 194), with a unit cell containing six atoms across two independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows Co centers with a close-packed-like local arrangement of twelve Sc neighbors, while Sc centers have fourteen geometric neighbors (six Co and eight Sc). The periodic neighbor graph is three-dimensional, and validated polyhedron contacts include corner-, edge-, and face-sharing between Sc-centered polyhedra, plus corner- and face-sharing between Co- and Sc-centered polyhedra.
